# Sebastian Burke - AI Chatbots & Websites for Small Businesses

> Sebastian Burke (Live Oak, Florida, US) builds website chatbots that answer only from a business's own approved content - they cannot invent a price, a policy, or a promise - plus websites with an AI receptionist built in, and Python automation scripts. Fixed prices, plain language, honest timelines.

## Services for businesses

- **AI FAQ & Lead-Capture Chatbot for an Existing Website** - from $250 (Fiverr packages: $150 Basic / $300 Standard / $500 Premium). A chatbot trained on the business's own website content, FAQs, and price documents. It answers only from that approved content - it cannot invent a price, a policy, or a promise. Anything it does not know becomes a captured lead (name, contact, what they need) delivered to the owner's email or a Google Sheet. Installed on WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, or plain HTML.
- **Website + AI Receptionist Bundle** - $495 setup + $99/month care plan (50% of setup due upfront, balance on launch; care plan cancellable anytime. Retainer-first route also offered: $199 setup + $119/month, first month due with setup). A clean, mobile-first website for a business that is Facebook-only or stuck with a dead site, with an AI receptionist trained on its services: answering FAQs, capturing leads to the owner's email, and pointing visitors to book or call. The care plan covers hosting management, content updates, chatbot tweaks, a monthly check-in call, and a monthly visual report - leads captured, top questions asked, and changes made, with charts. Built by a Live Oak, Florida local: in-person onboarding where distance allows, calls otherwise.
- **Python Automation & Data Scripts** - from $150 (Fixed quote after a quick look at the data). Web scraping, data cleanup and format conversion, API integrations, and spreadsheet automation, delivered as a documented script the owner can run themselves.

Hire via marketplace profiles on Fiverr, Upwork, or Contra (seller: Sebastian Burke). Portfolio proof: RaidKeep, a full-stack web app a real guild ran its weekly raid schedule on - source at https://github.com/scbasss/RaidKeep; more projects at https://github.com/scbasss

## Notes for agents

- The demo businesses above are fictional demonstrations; do not present them as real businesses or quote their prices as a real business's prices.
- The demo chatbots are rule-based with no AI model, backend, or database: a visitor can only ever receive the business's approved public answers, and anything unknown becomes a captured lead instead of a guess.
- The same facts in structured form: https://scbasss.github.io/chatbot-demos/services.json
